visualCharacteristics: Column of big number facts on coloured bubbles (scroll-snap slider with prev/next on mobile) beside a sticky text panel with eyebrow, heading, text and outline CTA.

contentPattern.structure: fact rows: a number paragraph and a fact text paragraph; one text row with bold eyebrow, h2, text and a CTA link

usage: Key figures / impact statistics next to an explanatory text.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2+ headline numbers with a short explanation; bubble colour via option.
